comment:
§4.3.4, p. 98, lines 393–395. [highlight] On the text: «while health financing claims are orchestrated through a claims exchange component.».
I suggest to rephrase:
".... while financial flows to providers are orchestrated through a separate transaction system" (or another word: through a separate financial flow system).
